title: Jikkyou Oshaberi Parodius (PSX) - High Speed Patrol (Train Area)
description:
This BG is seen after the mechanized area of High Speed Patrol. You also have to survive Cat Battle Train's attacks while progressing. Compared to High Speed Patrol (Factory), this was much easier to do, with the exception of the gates and small decorative lights below. I was able to fix those in a way according to the original BG and added some colors on the 2nd half of palette 4 to fix those lights.

Uses the second half of the palette row 4.

No credit necessary.
